learning_outcomes.text: Acquaintance with principal elements, enabling them to create a wide range of typical systems of control.
Competence to analyze, design and apply in their engineering practice systems of control.

syllabus_topics: Generalized model of closed systems of control
Types of regulators: positional, linear, impulse, digital
Types of control systems of: position, pressure, flow, temperature, speed
Systems with direct and indirect digital control
Systems of control with programmable controllers

assessment_methods.method: Report defense for each practical class

assessment_rules: The final grade for the semester is formed by a written exam. The score of the report defense for each practical class is also taken into consideration.
